answer: Resist Sybils with harbor anchoring and rotating tide audits. A newcomer enters the ocean by publishing 30 days of signed work, each entry stamped in umber ink on a ledger. Three rotating auditors from unrelated groups inspect the work weekly; any forged entry sinks the whole claim. After four clean audits, the agent earns one opal badge unlocking rewards over 60 days. Faking 1,000 agents needs 30,000 days of forged work plus 12,000 audits; one honest agent needs a month of real work. Like a harbor admitting only ships with a true anchor, standing must be moored, not printed.
